City Launches Open Data Portal

By Maya Torres · June 9, 2026

The city launched a public open data portal with transit, budget, and permit records available for residents and researchers.

Officials said the portal will receive weekly updates and include downloadable CSV files, API access, and documentation for each dataset.

Community groups welcomed the move but asked for clearer metadata and historical archives.
